findings.issue_text: app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:105-113 — `tu.notification_level = ...; tu.save!` bypasses `TopicUser.change` (the only mutation path that stamps `notifications_changed_at`/`notifications_reason_id` and publishes `notification_level_change` on MessageBus), so the row keeps `notifications_reason_id = NULL` and the app's own auto-track machinery (`TopicUser.auto_track` at topic_user.rb:37-49 `where(notifications_reason_id: nil)`, and `update_last_read` at topic_user.rb:160-167 `case when tu.notifications_reason_id is null and ... then :tracking`) silently flips the user's freshly-muted topic back to `tracking` the moment they read past `auto_track_topics_after` or post in it — the unsubscribe does not stick, and any other open tab for the topic never learns the level changed (severity P1, confidence 100)

app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:28,98 — the email unsubscribe link is bound to a browser session (`ensure_logged_in` on `:unsubscribe`) rather than to the email itself, while the same mailer already has a session-independent token pattern (`DigestUnsubscribeKey.create_key_for(@user)` at app/mailers/user_notifications.rb:84); a recipient who taps the link from a mail client where they are not logged in gets `Discourse::NotLoggedIn` which the HTML-GET rescue path renders as a 404 page with no login redirect or return_to, so the primary consumer of this feature (mobile mail readers) cannot unsubscribe at all (severity P1, confidence 75)

app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:107-111 — the level transition `> regular -> regular, else -> muted` is a toggle, not an idempotent "unsubscribe": a `watching` or `tracking` user (the population that actually receives reply emails) lands on `regular`, which still delivers replied/quoted/mentioned notifications and emails, directly contradicting the promises in server.en.yml:1855 "To stop receiving notifications about this particular topic" and client.en.yml:985 "You will stop receiving notifications for {{title}}"; only a second visit (or an F5 on the landing page) reaches `muted` (severity P2, confidence 100)

config/routes.rb:441-442 + app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:32 — a state mutation is served on a cookie-authenticated `GET` with `check_xhr` skipped, breaking the controller's own convention that every other TopicUser write is `put`/`post` (routes.rb:453-454 mute/unmute, :469 notifications); combined with the non-idempotent transition above, any cookie-carrying re-fetch the user did not intend (browser reload, back/forward re-navigation, Chrome/Safari link prerender, the 301 slug-mismatch redirect being retried) advances the state machine another step, and `/t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe.json` becomes a mutating GET JSON endpoint (severity P2, confidence 75)

app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:500 — adding an explicit `render :show` inside the shared `perform_show_response` moves template+layout rendering from end-of-action to mid-action, so in `show` the `canonical_url UrlHelper.absolute_without_cdn(...)` call at :87 now executes after the response body has already been built and `@canonical_url` never reaches the layout's `<link rel="canonical">` on any topic page (SEO duplicate-content regression on every crawled topic URL variant), a side effect of making a foreign action reuse `show`'s rendering pipeline instead of giving `unsubscribe` its own response (severity P2, confidence 75)

app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:105 — `TopicUser.find_by(...)` returns nil for any logged-in user without a topic_users row (direct navigation to `/t/:id/unsubscribe`, links forwarded to another member, rows never created for the destination after a merge/move), and `tu.notification_level` at :107 then raises NoMethodError -> 500 instead of creating the row; the canonical `TopicUser.change` already implements the update-or-create semantics this action needs (severity P2, confidence 75)

lib/email/message_builder.rb:67,90 + config/locales/server.en.yml:1852-1855 — the `unsubscribe_link` translation now requires `%{unsubscribe_url}` but `MessageBuilder` supplies no default for it, so `add_unsubscribe_link: true` (a public builder option) without an `unsubscribe_url` opt now raises `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument` from `body`/`html_part` and aborts the mail; every plugin or future mailer that passes `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without knowing about the new key breaks (severity P2, confidence 75)

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/app-route-map.js.es6:13 + app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6:4-10 — [advisory] the same URL `/t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe` now has two implementations with different semantics: the Rails action mutates and the Ember route only reads (`PostStream.loadTopicView` -> `/t/:id.json`), so any client-side transition to that URL (a link to it inside a post/PM intercepted by `Discourse.URL.routeTo`, back/forward re-entry) renders "You will stop receiving notifications" while nothing changed; the confirmation page should not be reachable without the write, or the write should be performed by the client route (severity P3, confidence 50)
